speaker-leads.name: Speaker leads
speaker-leads.description: Acquisition pipeline and speakers in your scope.

placeholder.title: Area prepared
placeholder.body: The foundation is in place: role gate, UI kit and languages already work here. This area's content lands in a later wave.

home.lead: Profile, programme, applications, tickets — maintain them once, valid across all formats.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: We'll email you a sign-in link. No password needed.
login.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to
login.authError: That link has expired or was already used. Please request a new one.

onboarding.title: Tell us briefly
onboarding.lead: Four steps, under three minutes. Everything except your name and the two checkboxes is optional and can wait.
onboarding.basicsHint: Your name and language end up on your badge and in our emails.
onboarding.optionalHint: All optional — it helps us suggest the right things.
onboarding.interestsHint: Pick what interests you. It shapes what we suggest.
onboarding.consentHint: We need the first two to register you at all.
onboarding.photoHint: Photos and videos from the event that show you.
onboarding.newsletterHint: A few emails a year about the programme and deadlines.

profile.title: My profile
profile.lead: Maintain your data once here — it applies across all formats.

sections.channels: How did you hear about ChefTreff?

programme.title: Programme
programme.lead: Everything that is published. Apply and register right here.
programme.emptyBody: Sessions appear here as soon as the programme team releases them.
programme.noMatchBody: No session matches these filters. Try removing one.
programme.ticketNote: You need a valid ticket to attend.
programme.consentShare: My application may be shown to the hosting partner.
programme.collisionBody: You already hold a confirmed spot at the same time. Confirming here withdraws the other one.

programme.title: Programme board
programme.lead: Stages as columns, 5-minute grid. Drag to move, the bottom edge changes the duration.
programme.hint: Double-click empty space to create a slot.
programme.confirmMoveBody: This session is already published. The change is immediately public and is recorded in the history.
programme.noEventBody: No event with stages exists for this edition yet. That comes from the migration's seed data.
programme.noDayBody: No days have been set up for this event yet.
programme.confirmHoursHint: Time from release to confirm an offer.
programme.questionsHint: From the question catalogue. Changes save immediately.

persons.title: People
persons.emptyBody: Records appear here as soon as someone signs in or legacy data is imported.

vocab.title: Vocabulary
vocab.lead: “active” controls whether a value is offered in the forms.

duplicates.title: Duplicate queue
duplicates.lead: Filled by the migration and the matching job.
duplicates.emptyBody: The queue fills up once legacy data is imported or people are merged.

mail.title: Mail delivery
mail.lead: Send a test email and check the most recent deliveries.
mail.resultSuppressed: Address is on the suppression list — not sent.
mail.dryRunHint: No RESEND_API_KEY set: the email was only written to the server log.

ui.title: UI kit
ui.lead: Every building block of the portal in one place — reference for reviews and new areas.

errors.forbiddenBody: You don't have a role for this area. If that looks wrong, contact the ChefTreff team.
